verdict.rationale:
Hightouch's Identity Resolution product explicitly links anonymous and known records across sources into one identity, supports survivorship rules to build a canonical 'golden record,' and is marketed to 'resolve identities across devices and channels' so teams work from one consistent customer view. This matches the story's core need for warehouse-native identity stitching with configurable rules.

missing for 10: granular documentation of the actual match-key/matching-logic configuration (deterministic vs probabilistic rules), concrete cross-device stitching walkthrough, and independent/hands-on corroboration of identity resolution accuracy.
